say:7:1710722006:1.text: Yet you still... worry over... a dying man like me...

say:8:1710722007:1.text: It's not a burden, Maximilian. As long as you're here, it's worth everything.
say:8:1710722007:1.source_cn: 不辛苦，马克西姆……只要你还在，这一切都是值得的。

say:9:1710722008:1.text: But this time, it isn't me... It's Merlin. Merlin has returned.
say:9:1710722008:1.source_cn: 不过，这次不是我……是梅林，梅林回来了。
say:9:1710722008:1.male: But this time, it isn't me... It's Merlin. Merlin has returned.
say:9:1710722008:1.female: But this time, it isn't me... It's Merlin. Merlin has returned.

say:11:1710722010:1.text: It really is you... our hero...
say:11:1710722010:1.male: It really is you... our hero...
say:11:1710722010:1.female: It really is you... our hero...

say:16:1710722014:1.text: I just need to rest... a little longer...

say:1:1710723001:1.text: Thank you for letting me speak to him clearly again, even if only for a moment.
say:1:1710723001:1.source_cn: 谢谢你……让我能再次与他这样清醒地说几句话，哪怕只是片刻。
say:1:1710723001:1.male: Thank you for letting me speak to him clearly again, even if only for a moment.
say:1:1710723001:1.female: Thank you for letting me speak to him clearly again, even if only for a moment.

say:2:1710723002:1.text: Seeing you stand in this room... it feels like no time has passed. But I know it must all feel strange to you now.
say:2:1710723002:1.source_cn: 看着你站在这里，仿佛又回到了从前……只是，如今的你，一...
say:2:1710723002:1.male: Seeing you stand in this room... it feels like no time has passed. But I know it must all feel strange to you now.
say:2:1710723002:1.female: Seeing you stand in this room... it feels like no time has passed. But I know it must all feel strange to you now.

choice_prompt:3:1710723002.text: Seeing you stand in this room... it feels like no time has passed. But I know it must all feel strange to you now.
choice_prompt:3:1710723002.source_cn: 看着你站在这里，仿佛又回到了从前……只是，如今的你，一定对这一切都感到陌生吧。
choice_prompt:3:1710723002.male: Seeing you stand in this room... it feels like no time has passed. But I know it must all feel strange to you now.
choice_prompt:3:1710723002.female: Seeing you stand in this room... it feels like no time has passed. But I know it must all feel strange to you now.

say:4:1710723003:1.text: Heh. You're the same as ever.
say:4:1710723003:1.male: Heh. You're the same as ever.
say:4:1710723003:1.female: Heh. You're the same as ever.

say:5:1710723004:1.text: Forgive me. I just... needed someone to listen.
say:5:1710723004:1.source_cn: 没什么，我只是……想找人说说话。
say:5:1710723004:1.male: Forgive me. I just... needed someone to listen.
say:5:1710723004:1.female: Forgive me. I just... needed someone to listen.

say:6:1710723005:1.text: Much has changed in the twenty years you were asleep.
say:6:1710723005:1.source_cn: 你沉睡的二十年，发生了太多的故事。
say:6:1710723005:1.male: Much has changed in the twenty years you were asleep.
say:6:1710723005:1.female: Much has changed in the twenty years you were asleep.

say:7:1710723006:1.text: Before that, I was still a wandering mage, moving from court to court, reading fates for coin and shelter.
say:7:1710723006:1.source_cn: 在那之前，我还只是穿梭于各势力之间、以占卜为名的游历法师。
say:7:1710723006:1.male: Before that, I was still a wandering mage, moving from court to court, reading fates for coin and shelter.
say:7:1710723006:1.female: Before that, I was still a wandering mage, moving from court to court, reading fates for coin and shelter.

say:8:1710723007:1.text: And Maximilian... was still the king who personally commanded in the Second Divine War.
say:8:1710723007:1.source_cn: 而马克西姆……还是那个在第二次神魔大战中亲自指挥的君王。
say:8:1710723007:1.male: And Maximilian... was still the king who personally commanded in the Second Divine War.
say:8:1710723007:1.female: And Maximilian... was still the king who personally commanded in the Second Divine War.

say:9:1710723008:1.text: We are no longer the people you once knew.
say:9:1710723008:1.source_cn: 我们都已不是你记忆中的模样了。
say:9:1710723008:1.male: We are no longer the people you once knew.
say:9:1710723008:1.female: We are no longer the people you once knew.

say:10:1710723009:1.text: The Second Divine War... do you recall any of it?
say:10:1710723009:1.source_cn: 第二次神魔大战……你还留有印象吗？
say:10:1710723009:1.male: The Second Divine War... do you recall any of it?
say:10:1710723009:1.female: The Second Divine War... do you recall any of it?

choice_prompt:11:1710723009.text: The Second Divine War... do you recall any of it?
choice_prompt:11:1710723009.source_cn: 第二次神魔大战……你还留有印象吗？
choice_prompt:11:1710723009.male: The Second Divine War... do you recall any of it?
choice_prompt:11:1710723009.female: The Second Divine War... do you recall any of it?

say:12:1710723010:1.text: I remember clearly: if you hadn't paid the price to seal the Hypofiends, the Lightbearer Empire might no longer exist today.
say:12:1710723010:1.source_cn: 我还清楚地记得——若非你在最后一刻，不惜以自身为代价，...
say:12:1710723010:1.male: I remember clearly: if you hadn't paid the price to seal the Hypofiends, the Lightbearer Empire might no longer exist today.
say:12:1710723010:1.female: I remember clearly: if you hadn't paid the price to seal the Hypofiends, the Lightbearer Empire might no longer exist today.

say:13:1710723011:1.text: I, too, did what little I could, but after you vanished, I grew tired of conflict. I buried myself in a tower and studied the stars...
say:13:1710723011:1.source_cn: 那时，我虽也在战争中略尽绵力，并因此为部分人所知，但在...
say:13:1710723011:1.male: I, too, did what little I could, but after you vanished, I grew tired of conflict. I buried myself in a tower and studied the stars...
say:13:1710723011:1.female: I, too, did what little I could, but after you vanished, I grew tired of conflict. I buried myself in a tower and studied the stars...

say:15:1710723013:1.text: He came, again and again. Not because I was Gawain of the Arcane Council—he didn't know that.
say:15:1710723013:1.source_cn: 他一次又一次，亲自来到我那座偏僻的塔楼。他并非为了找寻...
say:15:1710723013:1.male: He came, again and again. Not because I was Gawain of the Arcane Council—he didn't know that.
say:15:1710723013:1.female: He came, again and again. Not because I was Gawain of the Arcane Council—he didn't know that.

say:16:1710723014:1.text: He was simply... looking for Gwendolyn.
say:16:1710723014:1.male: He was simply... looking for Gwendolyn.
say:16:1710723014:1.female: He was simply... looking for Gwendolyn.

choice_prompt:17:1710723014.text: He was simply... looking for Gwendolyn.
choice_prompt:17:1710723014.male: He was simply... looking for Gwendolyn.
choice_prompt:17:1710723014.female: He was simply... looking for Gwendolyn.

say:18:1710723015:1.text: He had just lost his wife. The realm was struggling to rebuild...
say:18:1710723015:1.source_cn: 那时，他刚刚失去他的妻子，耀光也正处于艰难重建的时期……
say:18:1710723015:1.male: He had just lost his wife. The realm was struggling to rebuild...
say:18:1710723015:1.female: He had just lost his wife. The realm was struggling to rebuild...

say:19:1710723016:1.text: In those years, we became each other's only support.
say:19:1710723016:1.source_cn: 在那段岁月里，我们成为了彼此唯一的支撑。
say:19:1710723016:1.male: In those years, we became each other's only support.
say:19:1710723016:1.female: In those years, we became each other's only support.

say:20:1710723017:1.text: Later, he asked me to marry him. A few years after that, we had Peggy.
say:20:1710723017:1.source_cn: 后来，他决定迎娶我。几年之后，我们有了佩吉。
say:20:1710723017:1.male: Later, he asked me to marry him. A few years after that, we had Peggy.
say:20:1710723017:1.female: Later, he asked me to marry him. A few years after that, we had Peggy.

say:21:1710723018:1.text: All of this... while you slept.
say:21:1710723018:1.source_cn: 这些……都是在你沉睡的二十年里，悄然发生的事。
say:21:1710723018:1.male: All of this... while you slept.
say:21:1710723018:1.female: All of this... while you slept.

say:22:1710723019:1.text: I've told you all this because... it has been so long since I had someone I could truly speak to.
say:22:1710723019:1.source_cn: 对你说了这么多旧事……我只是，太久没有能倾诉的人了。
say:22:1710723019:1.male: I've told you all this because... it has been so long since I had someone I could truly speak to.
say:22:1710723019:1.female: I've told you all this because... it has been so long since I had someone I could truly speak to.

say:24:1710723020:1.text: Heh, friends who can share old stories are precious indeed.
say:24:1710723020:1.source_cn: 唉，能够谈论旧事的朋友是多么难得啊。

say:25:1710723021:1.text: Yes. Even if Merlin remembers none of it... he is still my oldest friend.
say:25:1710723021:1.source_cn: 的确如此，尽管梅林已经失忆了，但我始终是<male>他...
say:25:1710723021:1.male: Yes. Even if Merlin remembers none of it... he is still my oldest friend.
say:25:1710723021:1.female: Yes. Even if Merlin remembers none of it... she is still my oldest friend.

say:27:1710723022:1.text: Merlin. Thank you, for coming to Savannah.
say:27:1710723022:1.source_cn: 梅林，感谢你愿意接受邀请，来到赛凡纳。
say:27:1710723022:1.male: Merlin. Thank you, for coming to Savannah.
say:27:1710723022:1.female: Merlin. Thank you, for coming to Savannah.

say:28:1710723023:1.text: I truly appreciate all that you've done, whether as the Queen or as Gawain...
say:28:1710723023:1.source_cn: 我真心感激你所做的一切，无论是以王后还是高文的身份……
say:28:1710723023:1.male: I truly appreciate all that you've done, whether as the Queen or as Gawain...
say:28:1710723023:1.female: I truly appreciate all that you've done, whether as the Queen or as Gawain...

say:29:1710723024:1.text: Now... I wish to stay with Maximilian for a while.
say:29:1710723024:1.source_cn: 现在……我想再陪马克西姆一会儿。
say:29:1710723024:1.male: Now... I wish to stay with Maximilian for a while.
say:29:1710723024:1.female: Now... I wish to stay with Maximilian for a while.

say:30:1710723025:1.text: You've done enough for us. Go and rest, Merlin.
say:30:1710723025:1.source_cn: 你为我们做的已经够多了。去休息吧，梅林。
say:30:1710723025:1.male: You've done enough for us. Go and rest, Merlin.
say:30:1710723025:1.female: You've done enough for us. Go and rest, Merlin.

say:31:1710723026:1.text: The storm is not yet past. We will need you.
say:31:1710723026:1.source_cn: 接下来的风暴……我们仍需要你的力量。
say:31:1710723026:1.male: The storm is not yet past. We will need you.
say:31:1710723026:1.female: The storm is not yet past. We will need you.

say:33:1710723027:1.text: Come on, let's give them some space.
say:33:1710723027:1.source_cn: 走吧走吧，给他们留点空间。

choice:11:2:3.text: I heard I played a great role.
choice:11:2:3.source_cn: 听说我做出了巨大的贡献
choice:11:2:3.male: I heard I played a great role.
choice:11:2:3.female: I heard I played a great role.

choice:3:0:1.text: I don't remember ever being here.
choice:3:0:1.male: I don't remember ever being here.
choice:3:0:1.female: I don't remember ever being here.

say:0:1710725001:0.text: Gwyneth? What are you doing here?
say:0:1710725001:0.source_cn: 格温妮丝？你怎么在这里？
say:0:1710725001:0.male: Gwyneth? What are you doing here?
say:0:1710725001:0.female: Gwyneth? What are you doing here?

say:1:1710727001:1.text: I came to leave a letter for Peggy. I can't wait for her to return, I have to leave Savannah soon.
say:1:1710727001:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，我是来给佩吉留信的。我等不及她回来，得先行离...
say:1:1710727001:1.male: I came to leave a letter for Peggy. I can't wait for her to return, I have to leave Savannah soon.
say:1:1710727001:1.female: I came to leave a letter for Peggy. I can't wait for her to return, I have to leave Savannah soon.

choice_prompt:2:1710727001.text: I came to leave a letter for Peggy. I can't wait for her to return, I have to leave Savannah soon.
choice_prompt:2:1710727001.source_cn: 梅林阁下，我是来给佩吉留信的。我等不及她回来，得先行离开赛凡纳了。
choice_prompt:2:1710727001.male: I came to leave a letter for Peggy. I can't wait for her to return, I have to leave Savannah soon.
choice_prompt:2:1710727001.female: I came to leave a letter for Peggy. I can't wait for her to return, I have to leave Savannah soon.

say:3:1710727002:1.text: Yes. I've accepted the Prince's appointment to Ashvale County.
say:3:1710727002:1.source_cn: 是的。王子殿下任命我前往灰影郡前线的事，我已经接受了。
say:3:1710727002:1.male: Yes. I've accepted the Prince's appointment to Ashvale County.
say:3:1710727002:1.female: Yes. I've accepted the Prince's appointment to Ashvale County.

say:6:1710727004:1.source_cn: 我留在这里，也帮不上什么忙。

say:7:1710727005:1.text: Father still refuses to let me assist in the investigation.
say:7:1710727005:1.source_cn: 父亲他……依旧不让我插手调查。
say:7:1710727005:1.male: Father still refuses to let me assist in the investigation.
say:7:1710727005:1.female: Father still refuses to let me assist in the investigation.

say:8:1710727006:1.text: Perhaps he's right. Perhaps I'm just... a Dragonslayer Knight in name only.
say:8:1710727006:1.source_cn: 也许他说的是对的，我只是……空有狩龙骑士的虚名罢了。
say:8:1710727006:1.male: Perhaps he's right. Perhaps I'm just... a Dragonslayer Knight in name only.
say:8:1710727006:1.female: Perhaps he's right. Perhaps I'm just... a Dragonslayer Knight in name only.

say:9:1710727007:1.text: You remember her quick thinking and courage in the kitchen of Silken Snare.
say:9:1710727007:1.source_cn: 你想起了在丝绒陷阱后厨，她面对危机时的机智与勇敢。
say:9:1710727007:1.male: You remember her quick thinking and courage in the kitchen of Silken Snare.
say:9:1710727007:1.female: You remember her quick thinking and courage in the kitchen of Silken Snare.

say:10:1710727008:1.text: You also remember her fearless, precise shot at the hunting grounds.
say:10:1710727008:1.source_cn: 也想起了在狮心猎场，她射杀巨蛛时，那精准而无畏的一箭。
say:10:1710727008:1.male: You also remember her fearless, precise shot at the hunting grounds.
say:10:1710727008:1.female: You also remember her fearless, precise shot at the hunting grounds.

say:12:1710727009:1.text: It doesn't matter. Words alone don't earn trust.
say:12:1710727009:1.source_cn: 没有用，阁下。这并不能带来信任。
say:12:1710727009:1.male: It doesn't matter. Words alone don't earn trust.
say:12:1710727009:1.female: It doesn't matter. Words alone don't earn trust.

say:13:1710727012:1.text: Magister Merlin, you've seen far more of the world than I have. Please, tell me the truth.
say:13:1710727012:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，您见多识广。请您……请您告诉我实话。
say:13:1710727012:1.male: Magister Merlin, you've seen far more of the world than I have. Please, tell me the truth.
say:13:1710727012:1.female: Magister Merlin, you've seen far more of the world than I have. Please, tell me the truth.

say:14:1710727013:1.female: Am I... simply not good enough?

say:16:1710727014:1.female: You look at the bow across her back, and a bold idea begins to take shape. You remember how she earned the title of Dragonslayer Knight by slaying an earth drake, and the yearning in her eyes for true dragons.

say:17:1710727015:1.source_cn: 你想起她因猎杀地龙而获封狩龙骑士，想起她眼中对真正巨龙...

say:22:1710727018:1.text: You explain Aurora's ability, telling her that with your memories, she can make a dream where dragons roam.
say:22:1710727018:1.source_cn: 你向格温妮丝简要解释了一下奥萝菈的力量，并且告诉她可以...
say:22:1710727018:1.male: You explain Aurora's ability, telling her that with your memories, she can make a dream where dragons roam.
say:22:1710727018:1.female: You explain Aurora's ability, telling her that with your memories, she can make a dream where dragons roam.

say:23:1710727019:1.text: A realm without her father's shadow. She can face everything by her own will.
say:23:1710727019:1.source_cn: 在那里，没有她父亲的庇护，只有她和她的弓。她可以凭自己...

say:24:1710727020:1.text: I can challenge a real dragon?!
say:24:1710727020:1.male: I can challenge a real dragon?!
say:24:1710727020:1.female: I can challenge a real dragon?!

say:25:1710727021:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下！这……这真的可以吗？！

say:29:1710727023:0.text: Whew. Youth really does burn bright.

say:30:1710727024:1.source_cn: 不过这样也好，奥萝菈整天睡觉，也该多干点正事了！

say:31:1710727025:1.text: Let's go rouse that sleepy Celestial!

choice:27:1:2.text: In that case, let's leave Peggy's letter for later.
choice:27:1:2.source_cn: 给佩吉的信就晚点再留吧
choice:27:1:2.male: In that case, let's leave Peggy's letter for later.
choice:27:1:2.female: In that case, let's leave Peggy's letter for later.

choice:19:0:1.male: Perhaps you require a trial of your own making.
choice:19:0:1.female: Perhaps you require a trial of your own making.

choice:19:1:2.text: How about a battle to build confidence?
choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 不如来一场足以让你建立信心的战斗
choice:19:1:2.male: How about a battle to build confidence?
choice:19:1:2.female: How about a battle to build confidence?

say:33:1710727010:1.text: That's why I want to leave his shadow and see for myself whether I'm truly as unfit as he believes.
say:33:1710727010:1.source_cn: 所以我才想离开他的庇佑，去看看我究竟是不是他所认为的那...
say:33:1710727010:1.male: That's why I want to leave his shadow and see for myself whether I'm truly as unfit as he believes.
say:33:1710727010:1.female: That's why I want to leave his shadow and see for myself whether I'm truly as unfit as he believes.

choice:11:1:2.text: Your father's protecting you, just in the wrong way.
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 你的父亲只是用了错误的方式保护你
choice:11:1:2.male: Your father's protecting you, just in the wrong way.
choice:11:1:2.female: Your father's protecting you, just in the wrong way.

say:34:1710727011:1.text: Yes. I've made up my mind.
say:34:1710727011:1.male: Yes. I've made up my mind.
say:34:1710727011:1.female: Yes. I've made up my mind.

choice:11:2:3.text: It seems I won't be able to change your mind.
choice:11:2:3.male: It seems I won't be able to change your mind.
choice:11:2:3.female: It seems I won't be able to change your mind.

say:1:1710730001:1.text: Mm.. I had only just closed my eyes...

say:2:1710730002:1.text: My sincerest apologies, Lady Aurora. Please forgive our intrusion at such an hour.
say:2:1710730002:1.source_cn: 非常抱歉，奥萝菈冕下。请恕我们冒昧，在这个时间打扰您的安眠。

say:3:1710730003:1.text: Huh? I've never seen you before.

say:4:1710730004:1.text: My name is Gwyneth, and I...
say:4:1710730004:1.source_cn: 在下名为格温妮丝，是因为……

choice_prompt:5:1710730004.text: My name is Gwyneth, and I...
choice_prompt:5:1710730004.source_cn: 在下名为格温妮丝，是因为……

say:6:1710730005:1.text: You explain your idea in simple terms.
say:6:1710730005:1.source_cn: 你便将你的构想简单讲述了一遍——
say:6:1710730005:1.male: You explain your idea in simple terms.
say:6:1710730005:1.female: You explain your idea in simple terms.

say:7:1710730006:1.text: Using your memories to create an image of a dragon within Gwyneth's dream, making a trial for her.
say:7:1710730006:1.source_cn: 借助你的记忆，在格温妮丝梦中重现龙的身影，为她构建一场试炼。
say:7:1710730006:1.male: Using your memories to create an image of a dragon within Gwyneth's dream, making a trial for her.
say:7:1710730006:1.female: Using your memories to create an image of a dragon within Gwyneth's dream, making a trial for her.

say:8:1710730007:1.text: Of course, since it's a memory alone, no living thing will be harmed in the process!
say:8:1710730007:1.source_cn: 当然，由于是记忆所化，在此过程中不会有任何生灵受到伤害！

say:10:1710730008:1.text: A dragon, huh? Even I've only heard tales of such creatures.
say:10:1710730008:1.source_cn: ……龙吗？连我都只是听说过那种生物呢。
say:10:1710730008:1.male: A dragon, huh? Even I've only heard tales of such creatures.
say:10:1710730008:1.female: A dragon, huh? Even I've only heard tales of such creatures.

say:11:1710730009:1.text: I can slip into Merlin's dream first and obtain the image and memories of a dragon, then weave that into Gwyneth's dream.
say:11:1710730009:1.source_cn: 我可以先潜入梅林的梦境，把关于龙的形象和记忆投影出来。...
say:11:1710730009:1.male: I can slip into Merlin's dream first and obtain the image and memories of a dragon, then weave that into Gwyneth's dream.
say:11:1710730009:1.female: I can slip into Merlin's dream first and obtain the image and memories of a dragon, then weave that into Gwyneth's dream.

say:12:1710730010:1.text: Both of you will need to fall asleep.
say:12:1710730010:1.source_cn: 不过……你们俩都要睡下才行。
say:12:1710730010:1.male: Both of you will need to fall asleep.
say:12:1710730010:1.female: Both of you will need to fall asleep.

say:13:1710730011:1.text: Merlin, don't set up dream defenses this time, or I won't be able to reach you.
say:13:1710730011:1.source_cn: 梅林，这次不要在梦境里设下防御，不然我没法进入你的梦境……
say:13:1710730011:1.male: Merlin, don't set up dream defenses this time, or I won't be able to reach you.
say:13:1710730011:1.female: Merlin, don't set up dream defenses this time, or I won't be able to reach you.

choice_prompt:14:1710730011.text: Merlin, don't set up dream defenses this time, or I won't be able to reach you.
choice_prompt:14:1710730011.source_cn: 梅林，这次不要在梦境里设下防御，不然我没法进入你的梦境……
choice_prompt:14:1710730011.male: Merlin, don't set up dream defenses this time, or I won't be able to reach you.
choice_prompt:14:1710730011.female: Merlin, don't set up dream defenses this time, or I won't be able to reach you.

say:15:1710730012:1.text: Once I see the dragon, I'll leave. You'll wake quickly, Merlin.
say:15:1710730012:1.source_cn: 我看到龙就会离开了……梅林，你会很快醒来。
say:15:1710730012:1.male: Once I see the dragon, I'll leave. You'll wake quickly, Merlin.
say:15:1710730012:1.female: Once I see the dragon, I'll leave. You'll wake quickly, Merlin.

say:16:1710730013:1.text: As for you, Gwyneth... you'll sink into deep slumber and face the dragon directly.
say:16:1710730013:1.source_cn: 至于你，格温妮丝……你会陷入深层梦境，直面巨龙。

say:17:1710730014:1.text: Remember, dreams are projections of souls. The dragon comes from Merlin's memory, but how strong it becomes in your dream depends on your fear—or your fighting spirit.
say:17:1710730014:1.source_cn: 你要记住，梦境是灵魂深处的投射，虽然龙是梅林记忆里的，...
say:17:1710730014:1.male: Remember, dreams are projections of souls. The dragon comes from Merlin's memory, but how strong it becomes in your dream depends on your fear—or your fighting spirit.
say:17:1710730014:1.female: Remember, dreams are projections of souls. The dragon comes from Merlin's memory, but how strong it becomes in your dream depends on your fear—or your fighting spirit.

say:18:1710730015:1.text: The more afraid you are, the stronger it grows. And if your spirit breaks in the dream... your real self will suffer too. I don't want that to happen...
say:18:1710730015:1.source_cn: 你越害怕，它就越强大。如果你的意志在梦中崩溃了，现实中...

say:20:1710730016:1.text: I understand. Thank you for the warning, my lady.
say:20:1710730016:1.source_cn: 我明白了，多谢冕下的提醒。

say:21:1710730017:1.text: If too much time passes and you don't wake... I'll try to call you back.
say:21:1710730017:1.source_cn: 如果过了很久你还没有醒，我会试着去叫醒你的。

say:22:1710730018:1.text: If... I'm awake enough to do so...
say:22:1710730018:1.source_cn: 前提是……我那个时候，自己能醒得过来……

say:24:1710730019:1.text: Oh dear. Maybe try staying conscious just this once?
say:24:1710730019:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀，你坚持一下，别那么快睡着嘛！

say:25:1710730020:1.text: Mm... but this is how I always am...
say:25:1710730020:1.source_cn: 唔……但这就是我帮助大家的方法呀。

say:27:1710730021:1.text: Interrupting their bickering, you turn to Gwyneth and speak.
say:27:1710730021:1.source_cn: 你打断了他们两个的争执，转向了格温妮丝。
say:27:1710730021:1.male: Interrupting their bickering, you turn to Gwyneth and speak.
say:27:1710730021:1.female: Interrupting their bickering, you turn to Gwyneth and speak.

choice_prompt:28:1710730021.text: Interrupting their bickering, you turn to Gwyneth and speak.
choice_prompt:28:1710730021.source_cn: 你打断了他们两个的争执，转向了格温妮丝。
choice_prompt:28:1710730021.male: Interrupting their bickering, you turn to Gwyneth and speak.
choice_prompt:28:1710730021.female: Interrupting their bickering, you turn to Gwyneth and speak.

say:29:1710730022:1.source_cn: 是，梅林阁下！我准备好了！

say:31:1710730023:1.text: Then lie down... and close your eyes...

choice:28:0:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝，你准备好了吗？

choice:5:1:2.text: We'd like you to create a special dream.
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 想请你构建一个特殊的梦
choice:5:1:2.male: We'd like you to create a special dream.
choice:5:1:2.female: We'd like you to create a special dream.

choice:5:2:3.text: Gwyneth wants to undergo a trial.
choice:5:2:3.source_cn: 格温妮丝想要进行试炼
choice:5:2:3.male: Gwyneth wants to undergo a trial.
choice:5:2:3.female: Gwyneth wants to undergo a trial.

narration:1:1710731002:1.text: And with Aurora's craft, the dragon rises, woven from memory with Gwyneth's desire and fear...

narration:2:1710731003:1.text: The trial of the Dragonslayer Knight begins.

say:3:1710734001:0.text: Allo? Is that you?! Why are you here?
say:3:1710734001:0.source_cn: 艾尔？是你？！你怎么会在这里？

say:4:1710734002:0.text: It's me! I'm here with you!

say:6:1710734004:0.text: There are dark shapes over there... and they keep saying awful things!
say:6:1710734004:0.source_cn: 前面有好多可怕的黑影……他们一直在说着很坏的话！

say:7:1710734005:0.text: Don't worry! I'll protect you with my bow.
say:7:1710734005:0.source_cn: 别怕，艾尔！我会用我的弓保护你。

say:8:1710734006:0.text: Gwyneth reaches for her back—and finds nothing.
say:8:1710734006:0.source_cn: 格温妮丝下意识地反手去摸背后的长弓，却只摸到了一片虚无。

say:10:1710734008:0.text: Don't worry, Gwyneth! You have to believe in yourself!
say:10:1710734008:0.source_cn: 别担心！格温妮丝，一定要相信自己！

say:12:1710734010:0.text: Find your bow, and your true self!
say:12:1710734010:0.source_cn: 把你的弓，和真正的自己，都找回来！

say:0:1710739101:0.text: Beware of those ominous shadows, Gwyneth!
say:0:1710739101:0.source_cn: 这些就是可怕的黑影了！格温妮丝，一定要小心！

say:1:1710739102:0.text: I will, Allo. And I'll keep you safe.

say:0:1710739201:0.text: ... Lava just keeps seeping out of the ground! How scary!

say:1:1710739202:0.text: We just have to watch our step in this area.

say:0:1710739401:0.text: We'll have to keep firing at the mechanism to move forward.
say:0:1710739401:0.source_cn: 前面只能依靠连续射击机关移动了。

say:1:1710739402:0.text: Allo, why don't you fly over first? I'll catch up soon!
say:1:1710739402:0.source_cn: 艾尔，你先飞过去，在前面等我，我很快过去！

say:1:1710740002:0.text: Gwyneth, I'm sure you can slay the dragon!
say:1:1710740002:0.source_cn: 格温妮丝，你一定能打败巨龙！

say:0:1710740101:0.text: That device... just like in the depths of Silken Snare.
say:0:1710740101:0.source_cn: 那是……和丝绒陷阱后厨一样的机关？

say:1:1710740102:0.text: I see. I need to activate them with arrows and leap forward!
say:1:1710740102:0.source_cn: 我明白了，我得靠着射箭激活机关，跳跃着前进！

say:0:1710740301:0.text: We have to dodge the flames as we move.
say:0:1710740301:0.source_cn: 不行，得先躲过巨龙的喷火，才能移动。

say:0:1710740401:0.text: Now that the fire zone is behind us, it's finally time to confront the dragon...
say:0:1710740401:0.source_cn: 龙焰喷发的区域过了，终于要直面巨龙了吗……

say:1:1710741201:0.text: That shadow... it looks like you!
say:1:1710741201:0.source_cn: 格温妮丝，快看，这个影子……好像你！

say:3:1710741203:1.text: So in the end, the one I had to defeat was never some dragon...
say:3:1710741203:1.source_cn: 原来，在这个漫长梦境的尽头，我要战胜的从来都不是什么巨龙……

say:4:1710741204:1.text: But the girl who always stood in her father's shadow.
say:4:1710741204:1.source_cn: 而是那个总是害怕让父亲失望，总是觉得“不配”的我自己……

say:6:1710741206:1.text: It's alright. I used to say I didn't care about their doubts and quiet scorn.
say:6:1710741206:1.source_cn: 没关系，艾尔。我只是发现，那些旁人的质疑、嘲笑、否定…...

say:7:1710741207:1.text: But I did care. I buried them deep, until they grew into this.
say:7:1710741207:1.source_cn: 但其实，是我自己把它们捡了起来，藏在心底，一点点喂养成...

say:8:1710741208:1.text: I let this self doubt loom over me, mocking every effort I made.
say:8:1710741208:1.source_cn: 是我允许这个“自我怀疑”站在高处，时刻俯视着我，嘲弄我...

say:9:1710741209:1.text: But now, I'm not afraid anymore.

say:10:1710741210:1.text: I'm not perfect. I may still fail. But that doesn't matter.
say:10:1710741210:1.source_cn: 我不完美，我也许还会失败。但这都不重要了。

say:11:1710741211:1.text: I don't need to prove to anyone that I deserve to stand here.
say:11:1710741211:1.source_cn: 我不需要再拼命向谁去证明，我有资格站在这里。

say:12:1710741212:1.text: I am Gwyneth, and the bow in my hands is my only answer!
say:12:1710741212:1.source_cn: 我是格温妮丝。手中的弓，就是我唯一的回答！

narration:0:1710743001:1.text: Deep in the dream, the burden that Gwyneth carried for years has finally disappeared.

narration:1:1710743002:1.text: Elsewhere, your own mind rises slowly to the surface.
narration:1:1710743002:1.male: Elsewhere, your own mind rises slowly to the surface.
narration:1:1710743002:1.female: Elsewhere, your own mind rises slowly to the surface.

say:4:1710744003:1.text: Gwyneth will remain in the dream a while longer.
say:4:1710744003:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝还得在梦境，再待上一段时间。
say:4:1710744003:1.male: Gwyneth will remain in the dream a while longer.
say:4:1710744003:1.female: Gwyneth will remain in the dream a while longer.

say:5:1710744004:1.text: I'll stay and keep watch. She's stubborn, and might try something reckless...
say:5:1710744004:1.source_cn: 我得好好在梦境里看着她，她是个顽强的小姑娘，可能会乱来呢……
say:5:1710744004:1.male: I'll stay and keep watch. She's stubborn, and might try something reckless...
say:5:1710744004:1.female: I'll stay and keep watch. She's stubborn, and might try something reckless...

say:8:1710744006:1.text: Oh dear... leaving Gwyneth alone with this sleepyhead here? Are we quite certain that's wise?
say:8:1710744006:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀，把格温妮丝交给这个瞌睡虫，真的没问题吗？

say:10:1710744007:1.text: Every lead has been followed. The final piece has been set in motion.
say:10:1710744007:1.source_cn: 所有的线索都已查明，最后一步棋也已布下。

say:11:1710744008:1.text: There's nothing left to do in the palace. Now, you wait.
say:11:1710744008:1.source_cn: 你们在王宫里已经没什么可做了，剩下的，只有等待。

say:13:1710744009:1.text: Mm. Fair. It's been a long day.
say:13:1710744009:1.source_cn: 唔……说得也是，累了一天了。
say:13:1710744009:1.male: Mm. Fair. It's been a long day.
say:13:1710744009:1.female: Mm. Fair. It's been a long day.

say:14:1710744010:1.text: This fox needs his beauty sleep too!
say:14:1710744010:1.male: This fox needs his beauty sleep too!
say:14:1710744010:1.female: This fox needs his beauty sleep too!

say:0:1710745001:0.text: Move, move! Tonight's banquet is critical!
say:0:1710745001:0.source_cn: 手脚麻利点！今日的晚宴很重要！

say:1:1710745002:0.text: Polish the silverware until I can see my reflection!

say:3:1710745004:0.text: Watch it. That's the vintage reserve!
say:3:1710745004:0.source_cn: 小心，这可是窖藏的佳酿！

say:4:1710745005:0.text: Will the final course arrive in time?

say:1:1710747001:1.source_cn: 打扰您了，阁下。今日宫中事务繁杂，若有失礼之处还请您见谅。

say:1:1710747001:1.female: My apologies for the disruption. Palace affairs are unusually hectic today.

choice_prompt:2:1710747001.female: My apologies for the disruption. Palace affairs are unusually hectic today.

say:3:1710747003:1.source_cn: 想必您也知晓今日狮心猎场发生的意外。

say:3:1710747003:1.female: I assume you've heard about the incident at the hunting grounds this afternoon.

"Reassure" them?
... Sounds more like hushing up and currying favor, if you ask me.

choice:2:1:2.text: Are you setting up a banquet?
choice:2:1:2.male: Are you setting up a banquet?
choice:2:1:2.female: Are you setting up a banquet?

say:1:1710748001:1.text: Dura above! Magister Merlin! Please forgive me!
say:1:1710748001:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上！梅林阁下！万分抱歉！
say:1:1710748001:1.male: Dura above! Magister Merlin! Please forgive me!
say:1:1710748001:1.female: Dura above! Magister Merlin! Please forgive me!

say:2:1710748002:1.text: I meant no disrespect. I was simply absorbed in my work, I didn't mean to—
say:2:1710748002:1.source_cn: 请您宽恕我的无礼！我……我实在太专注于手上的工作了，绝...
say:2:1710748002:1.male: I meant no disrespect. I was simply absorbed in my work, I didn't mean to—
say:2:1710748002:1.female: I meant no disrespect. I was simply absorbed in my work, I didn't mean to—

choice_prompt:3:1710748002.male: I meant no disrespect. I was simply absorbed in my work, I didn't mean to—
choice_prompt:3:1710748002.female: I meant no disrespect. I was simply absorbed in my work, I didn't mean to—

say:5:1710748005:1.text: We're preparing for tonight's banquet. It's all come together so suddenly, everyone's in a panic.
say:5:1710748005:1.source_cn: 我们在筹备今晚的晚宴，实在太过于紧急了，以至于大家都手...
say:5:1710748005:1.male: We're preparing for tonight's banquet. It's all come together so suddenly, everyone's in a panic.
say:5:1710748005:1.female: We're preparing for tonight's banquet. It's all come together so suddenly, everyone's in a panic.

say:6:1710748006:1.text: His Highness even commissioned dishes from the capital's most famous establishment—Silken Snare.
say:6:1710748006:1.source_cn: 还是王子殿下体恤我们——殿下亲自出面，从王都那家最著名...
say:6:1710748006:1.male: His Highness even commissioned dishes from the capital's most famous establishment—Silken Snare.
say:6:1710748006:1.female: His Highness even commissioned dishes from the capital's most famous establishment—Silken Snare.

choice_prompt:7:1710748006.text: His Highness even commissioned dishes from the capital's most famous establishment—Silken Snare.
choice_prompt:7:1710748006.source_cn: 还是王子殿下体恤我们——殿下亲自出面，从王都那家最著名的丝绒陷阱餐厅内订购了这些美味佳肴。
choice_prompt:7:1710748006.male: His Highness even commissioned dishes from the capital's most famous establishment—Silken Snare.
choice_prompt:7:1710748006.female: His Highness even commissioned dishes from the capital's most famous establishment—Silken Snare.

say:8:1710748007:1.text: Yes, Magister. Is there something else you require?
say:8:1710748007:1.source_cn: 正式如此。梅林阁下，请问您还有什么吩咐吗？
say:8:1710748007:1.male: Yes, Magister. Is there something else you require?
say:8:1710748007:1.female: Yes, Magister. Is there something else you require?

say:9:1710748008:1.text: I really must finish arranging the service before the guests are seated.
say:9:1710748008:1.source_cn: 我得快些将餐品摆放整齐，以免影响稍后的开席。
say:9:1710748008:1.male: I really must finish arranging the service before the guests are seated.
say:9:1710748008:1.female: I really must finish arranging the service before the guests are seated.

choice_prompt:10:1710748008.male: I really must finish arranging the service before the guests are seated.
choice_prompt:10:1710748008.female: I really must finish arranging the service before the guests are seated.

say:13:1710748010:1.text: Food from Voracia's kitchen? Now that's interesting. What exactly is Orion planning tonight...?
say:13:1710748010:1.source_cn: 法蒂玛的餐品吗？小王子又计划了什么吗？

choice:3:0:1.text: It's fine. What are you working on?
choice:3:0:1.male: It's fine. What are you working on?
choice:3:0:1.female: It's fine. What are you working on?

say:15:1710748004:1.text: Please, mercy! I'll tell you everything!
say:15:1710748004:1.source_cn: 请求你发发慈悲，我会向您解释的。
say:15:1710748004:1.male: Please, mercy! I'll tell you everything!
say:15:1710748004:1.female: Please, mercy! I'll tell you everything!

choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 没那么简单，先说说你在干什么？

say:1:1710749001:1.text: A sudden banquet with food from Silken Snare...
say:1:1710749001:1.source_cn: 临时的宴会，丝绒陷阱的食物……

choice_prompt:2:1710749001.text: A sudden banquet with food from Silken Snare...
choice_prompt:2:1710749001.source_cn: 临时的宴会，丝绒陷阱的食物……

say:3:1710749002:1.text: So swiftly, too. Almost as though he's been waiting for an excuse.
say:3:1710749002:1.male: So swiftly, too. Almost as though he's been waiting for an excuse.
say:3:1710749002:1.female: So swiftly, too. Almost as though he's been waiting for an excuse.

say:4:1710749003:1.text: Is he trying to paint himself as composed and compassionate?
say:4:1710749003:1.source_cn: 是想把自己塑造成一个临危不惧、体恤下属的形象吗？
say:4:1710749003:1.male: Is he trying to paint himself as composed and compassionate?
say:4:1710749003:1.female: Is he trying to paint himself as composed and compassionate?

say:7:1710749005:1.text: Either way, we shouldn't leave the palace yet.
say:7:1710749005:1.source_cn: 看来，我们不能就这么离开王宫了。
say:7:1710749005:1.male: Either way, we shouldn't leave the palace yet.
say:7:1710749005:1.female: Either way, we shouldn't leave the palace yet.

say:8:1710749006:1.text: We should find a place to observe discreetly.
say:8:1710749006:1.male: We should find a place to observe discreetly.
say:8:1710749006:1.female: We should find a place to observe discreetly.

choice_prompt:9:1710749006.text: We should find a place to observe discreetly.
choice_prompt:9:1710749006.male: We should find a place to observe discreetly.
choice_prompt:9:1710749006.female: We should find a place to observe discreetly.

say:10:1710749007:1.text: It's quiet, with a clear view of the banquet chamber.
say:10:1710749007:1.source_cn: 那里既安静，又能观察到宴会厅。

say:11:1710749008:1.text: Rarely used without prior notice. It's ideal.
say:11:1710749008:1.source_cn: 短时间内也不会有王室成员使用，是个暗中观察的好地方。

say:12:1710749009:1.text: Heh. And if anyone spots us, we can always just slip into the Hall of Omens!
say:12:1710749009:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，没问题！如果被人发现了，还能往预兆密阁里躲躲！

choice:9:0:1.text: Let's go to the audience hall.
choice:9:0:1.male: Let's go to the audience hall.
choice:9:0:1.female: Let's go to the audience hall.

choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 王子一定有什么新行动了

say:0:1710750001:0.text: Let's see what the Prince has prepared!
say:0:1710750001:0.source_cn: 就在这里看看王子演什么好戏吧！

say:2:1710754001:1.text: Your Highness, the inconvenient clamor has ceased. The stage you requested is prepared.
say:2:1710754001:1.source_cn: 殿下，不合时宜的喧闹终于平息了。为您准备的舞台也已布置妥当。

say:3:1710754002:1.text: Tonight's feast was merely a stopgap measure.
say:3:1710754002:1.source_cn: 迪尔格雷，今夜这场宴会终究是权宜之计……

say:4:1710754003:0.text: What comes next is what truly matters.
say:4:1710754003:0.source_cn: 接下来的事，才是重中之重。

say:5:1710754004:0.text: We cannot afford another "accident" like earlier!
say:5:1710754004:0.source_cn: 绝不能再出现白天的意外！

say:7:1710754006:0.text: This afternoon was merely a prelude to your grand finale.
say:7:1710754006:0.source_cn: 白日不过是小小插曲，是为您那盛大剧目的终章……略作点缀罢了。

say:8:1710754007:0.text: The curtain has risen precisely on schedule. No uninvited guest will disrupt what follows.
say:8:1710754007:0.source_cn: 帷幕已在您我计划中升起，绝不会再被任何不速之客所打乱。

say:9:1710754008:1.text: When you return in triumph, before the eyes of the realm, the final act will unfold flawlessly.
say:9:1710754008:1.source_cn: 待您在万众瞩目下凯旋归来，这出戏的最后一幕便可完美启幕。

narration:0:1710755001:1.text: Time passes. Baron Grandet stirs from uneasy sleep...

say:0:1710756001:0.text: W-where is this? Why am I here?!
say:0:1710756001:0.source_cn: 这、这这里是哪里啊？！我、我我怎么在这里？

say:1:1710756002:0.text: I was... I was dining with His Highness, was I not...?
say:1:1710756002:0.source_cn: 我、我不是在跟王子殿下共进晚宴吗……

say:0:1710757001:0.text: I suppose... I should walk forward...

say:2:1710759001:1.text: Dura above! Your Grace! You're here as well!
say:2:1710759001:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上！亲王殿下！您也在这里！真是太好了！

say:3:1710759002:1.text: W-where exactly are we? Last I recall, His Highness was hosting a truly magnificent banquet...
say:3:1710759002:1.source_cn: 这、这到底是何处啊？我只记得王子殿下那场无与伦比的晚宴……

say:4:1710759003:1.text: Silence, Grandet. Are you entirely without perception?
say:4:1710759003:1.source_cn: 哼……闭嘴！你的脑子呢，葛朗台男爵？

say:5:1710759004:1.text: Look at the statues. The vaulted ceiling.
say:5:1710759004:1.source_cn: 你难道看不出这标志性的雕像和拱顶吗？

say:7:1710759006:1.text: This is the Hall of Ancients.

say:8:1710759007:1.text: Your Grace... you cannot be serious.

say:9:1710759008:1.source_cn: 圣古堂……圣古堂它不是……它不是……消失了吗？

say:10:1710759009:1.text: And yet here we stand. Everyone who attended that banquet.
say:10:1710759009:1.source_cn: 哼……但我们，所有参加晚宴的人，现在都在这座消失的教堂里。

say:11:1710759010:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上！我们、我们被困住了？！

say:12:1710759011:1.text: Your Grace! You must do something! I don't want to—
say:12:1710759011:1.source_cn: 殿下！亲王殿下！您想想办法啊！我、我不想——

say:14:1710759013:1.text: I have no idea why Orion invited someone like you to the hunt.
say:14:1710759013:1.source_cn: 真不知道奥利安为什么会邀请你这种货色参加行猎……

say:1:1710760001:1.text: Is this really the Hall of Ancients?

say:2:1710760002:1.text: I can't take it! I keep hearing something skittering in the walls!
say:2:1710760002:1.source_cn: 我受不了了！我好像听到了什么东西在爬……

say:5:1710760004:1.text: ... I don't want to believe it either. But this place... Last time I was here—
say:5:1710760004:1.source_cn: ……虽然我也不愿相信，但这里，我上次来的时候——

say:6:1710760005:1.source_cn: 坦尼斯！上次……上次你们遇到了什么？

say:7:1710760006:1.source_cn: ……魔物。如潮水一般汹涌而来的魔物。

say:8:1710760007:1.source_cn: 我们、我们根本无法抵抗。

say:12:1710760010:1.text: Don't worry. We all made it through before.
say:12:1710760010:1.source_cn: 别担心，我们最后都没事！

say:13:1710760011:1.text: Excalibur... it blazed. Like the Great Emperor himself was watching over us. That light saved us.
say:13:1710760011:1.source_cn: 圣古堂中供奉的石中剑仿佛是大帝显灵，爆发出了圣光！那把...

say:14:1710760012:1.text: Light...? Count Tannis, are you certain it will appear again?
say:14:1710760012:1.source_cn: 圣光……？坦尼斯伯爵，你确定这次……那圣光还会再出现吗？

say:15:1710760013:1.text: We were all at the Prince's banquet... How can this be...?
say:15:1710760013:1.source_cn: 毕竟我们，明明都在王子的晚宴上……

say:16:1710760014:1.text: Where is His Highness? Is the Prince here too?
say:16:1710760014:1.source_cn: 王子殿下呢？奥利安殿下也在这里吗？

say:18:1710760015:1.text: We have to find him! We're his guests, after all!
say:18:1710760015:1.source_cn: 我们得找到王子殿下！我们是他的客人啊！

say:19:1710760016:1.text: He was fearless during the hunt. If he's here, he'll protect us for sure!
say:19:1710760016:1.source_cn: 殿下在猎场上何等英勇，他如果也在这里，一定会保护我们的！

say:0:1710761001:0.source_cn: 王子殿下……王子殿下……在哪呢？

say:1:1710763001:1.text: Your Highness! It's you! Please, look, this place...
say:1:1710763001:1.source_cn: 殿下！真的是您！您快看，这里是……

say:2:1710763002:0.text: I know. You're not mistaken. This is the Hall of Ancients.
say:2:1710763002:0.source_cn: 我知道。诸位，你们没有看错。这里就是消失的圣古堂。

say:5:1710763004:0.text: Don't give in to fear. The Hall of Ancients is the Lightbearer Empire's most sacred ground.
say:5:1710763004:0.source_cn: 无需过度惊慌。圣古堂是耀光的圣所。

say:7:1710763005:0.text: Its lower halls hold the Empire's fallen heroes, and its dome bathes in Dura's divine light.
say:7:1710763005:0.source_cn: 它的底层，长眠着护国的英烈，它的穹顶，沐浴着艾雅女神的圣光。

say:8:1710763006:0.text: I don't know what power brought us here.
say:8:1710763006:0.source_cn: 我不知道是何种伟力，将我们从晚宴上齐聚于此。

say:9:1710763007:0.text: But I believe that we were brought here for a reason, as pillars of this Empire.
say:9:1710763007:0.source_cn: 但我坚信，在此刻，我们——耀光的砥柱——能被选召到这圣...

say:11:1710763008:0.text: Orion speaks wisely. Panic achieves nothing. We just need to figure out how to leave.
say:11:1710763008:0.source_cn: 奥利安殿下所言甚是。现在惊慌无用，我们只需要知道，该如...

say:13:1710763009:0.source_cn: 没错，现在最重要的是，收起你们的恐惧。

say:14:1710763010:0.text: As long as I stand here, I will protect you.
say:14:1710763010:0.source_cn: 只要我奥利安还站在这里，我就会竭尽全力，保护诸位的安全。

say:15:1710763011:0.text: No harm will come to anyone under my watch.
say:15:1710763011:0.source_cn: 我绝不会让任何人，在我的庇护下出事！

say:16:1710763012:0.source_cn: 王子的话音刚刚落下，承诺仿佛还在圣古堂内回响之际——

say:17:1710763013:1.text: A piercing shriek cuts through the hall!
say:17:1710763013:1.source_cn: 一阵令人牙酸的尖啸声，从远处猛然传来！

say:1:1710765001:1.text: That's the Mirror Wraith... from the First Divine War...
say:1:1710765001:1.source_cn: 那是……魔灵镜影……是第一次神魔大战时的……！

say:6:1710765005:0.text: You dare defile this sanctuary, the very ground Rolan walked?!
say:6:1710765005:0.source_cn: 罗兰大帝战胜过的魔物，也敢在圣古堂放肆！

say:8:1710765007:0.text: Mirror Wraith! I, descendant of the first king, will strike you down!
say:8:1710765007:0.source_cn: 魔灵镜影！我，罗兰大帝的子孙，将再次击败你——

narration:0:1710768001:1.text: Shouts of "Long live!" echo through the hall, but then...

narration:1:1710768002:1.text: Grandet suddenly feels a wave of dizziness, stronger than at the banquet.

narration:2:1710768003:1.text: The Prince's heroic figure, the nobles' cheers, they fade, distant and hazy.

say:1:1710770001:1.text: Forgive my surprise. Just a moment ago, this hall was empty. Can anyone explain where, exactly, you've been?
say:1:1710770001:1.source_cn: 请原谅我的惊讶。但就在刚才，这座大厅还空无一人。可否请...

say:2:1710770002:1.text: Judging by your expressions, I take it you weren't enjoying a pleasant dinner...
say:2:1710770002:1.source_cn: 看你们的神色，并非在享受一场美妙的晚宴啊……

say:3:1710770003:1.text: Magister Cyran! Thank heavens you're here!
say:3:1710770003:1.source_cn: 迪尔格雷大人！您来得正好！

say:4:1710770004:1.text: W-we went to the Hall of Ancients!
say:4:1710770004:1.source_cn: 我们、我们去了圣古堂！那个消失的圣古堂！

say:5:1710770005:1.text: That's not all! There was a Hypofiend, too. The Mirror Wraith I've seen in history books!
say:5:1710770005:1.source_cn: 不仅如此！还有……还有魔物！就是史书上的那个魔灵镜影！

say:7:1710770006:1.source_cn: 但！但是王子殿下……奥利安殿下他……

say:8:1710770007:1.text: His Highness the Prince is nothing short of a hero! He vanquished that dreadful monster entirely!
say:8:1710770007:1.source_cn: 王子殿下是英雄！他、他把那个魔物打倒了！

say:9:1710770008:1.text: Quite like King Rolan reborn, I daresay! And we were fortunate enough to witness every moment of it!
say:9:1710770008:1.source_cn: 就像罗兰大帝一样！我们都亲眼看到了！

say:11:1710770009:1.text: Is that so? Such a miracle...

say:12:1710770010:1.text: Wait... If the monster was defeated and we're back...
say:12:1710770010:1.source_cn: ……等等。既然魔物被打倒了，我们也都回来了……

say:14:1710770012:1.text: Surely he's not still trapped in the chapel?! To save us?!
say:14:1710770012:1.source_cn: 难道……殿下他为了救我们，还被困在那该死的教堂里？！

say:16:1710770013:1.text: This is a disaster! What do we do?!

say:17:1710770014:1.text: Magister Cyran. You are the Chief Court Mage. What's your assessment?
say:17:1710770014:1.source_cn: ……迪尔格雷卿，你是宫廷首席法师。对此，你有什么看法？

say:18:1710770015:1.text: Everyone, stay calm. Recall everything you witnessed.
say:18:1710770015:1.source_cn: 诸位，请冷静。请仔细回想你们所见证的一切。

say:20:1710770017:1.text: This was no disaster. It was a <style="highlight">trial</style>, and you, my lords and ladies, you were chosen as witnesses.
say:20:1710770017:1.source_cn: 这难道是一场灾难吗？不，这是一场<style=high...

say:21:1710770018:1.text: Prince Orion is not trapped. He has been <style="highlight">chosen</style>. He defeated Hypofiends and protected his people. This is the path of kings, as Rolan once walked.
say:21:1710770018:1.source_cn: 奥利安殿下并非被困住了。他是被<style=highl...

say:22:1710770019:1.text: You returned safely because your role as witnesses was complete. As for the Prince remaining there...
say:22:1710770019:1.source_cn: 你们平安归来，是因为你们的见证使命已经完成。而殿下之所...

say:23:1710770020:1.text: Does that not suggest he awaits <style="highlight">divine coronation</style> in that hall?
say:23:1710770020:1.source_cn: 难道不是意味着，他正在那座神圣的殿堂里，等待接受<st...

say:24:1710770021:1.source_cn: 接受加冕……你是说，石中剑？

say:26:1710770022:1.text: ... Yes! A trial! And to think, we have been so fortunate as to be chosen to witness it with our own humble eyes! He is the destined one!
say:26:1710770022:1.source_cn: ……没错！是试炼！一定是试炼！我们是被选中的见证者！奥...

say:27:1710770023:1.text: But when will His Highness return?
say:27:1710770023:1.source_cn: 那殿下什么时候才能回来？

say:28:1710770024:1.text: Do not worry. The Prince will return. And when he does, he will bring the Hall of Ancients with him, carrying Dura's glory!
say:28:1710770024:1.source_cn: 无需担忧。王子殿下必将归来！而且，当他归来之时，他必将...

say:29:1710770025:1.text: The Empire... will witness a true miracle!
say:29:1710770025:1.source_cn: 耀光……将迎来真正的神迹！

say:31:1710770026:1.source_cn: 天命所归……这才是真正的天命所归啊！

say:32:1710770027:1.text: Everyone. There is no need to continue tonight's banquet.
say:32:1710770027:1.source_cn: 诸位。今夜的宴会，已经没有继续的必要了。

say:34:1710770028:1.text: Return and rest. Then, let us await Prince Orion's...
say:34:1710770028:1.source_cn: 请先行回去休息，养足精神。然后……让我们一起静候奥利安...

narration:0:1710771001:1.text: The nobles leave in awe, still murmuring of miracles and Prince Orion's name.

narration:1:1710771002:1.text: Once the hall is silent, you and the little fox step out from the shadows.
narration:1:1710771002:1.male: Once the hall is silent, you and the little fox step out from the shadows.

narration:0:1721801001:0.text: The dark shadows within Gwyneth waver and dissipate, and the voices of doubt that tormented her finally fall silent...
narration:0:1721801001:0.source_cn: 格温妮丝内心的负面阴影在哀嚎中消散，那些嘈杂的低语终于...

narration:1:1721801002:0.text: Gwyneth opens her eyes and finds herself back in the real world.
narration:1:1721801002:0.source_cn: 格温妮丝睁开了双眼，看到的不再是无尽的挣扎，而是现实中...

cinematic_dialogue:2:1710737004:.text: You only bring sorrow to those who love you.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1710737004:.source_cn: 你只会让关心你的人失望<key:dialog2>

say:5:1710738002:1.text: Your voices... you've poisoned me long enough.
say:5:1710738002:1.source_cn: 你们这些声音……在我耳边低语了太久太久……

say:7:1710738004:1.text: I'm no longer the child hiding beneath her father's cloak!
say:7:1710738004:1.source_cn: 我不再是那个永远需要父亲庇护的孩子！

say:8:1710738005:1.text: Nor the captain who's only fit to hold flowers at ceremonies!
say:8:1710738005:1.source_cn: 也不再是那个只配捧着鲜花的守备军队长！

say:9:1710738006:1.text: I am the one who stood on the training grounds, day after day, and drew my bowstring a thousand times—
say:9:1710738006:1.source_cn: 我是那个在训练场上，日复一日拉开千百次弓弦的人——

cinematic_dialogue:14:1710737004:.text: You only bring sorrow to those who love you.
cinematic_dialogue:14:1710737004:.source_cn: 你只会让关心你的人失望<key:dialog2>

say:5:1710751001:0.text: I've asked you here tonight on account of this afternoon's events at the hunting grounds. The sudden attack must have unsettled you all.
say:5:1710751001:0.source_cn: 诸位，今夜宴请是为了白日猎场之事。那突如其来的袭击，想...

say:6:1710751002:0.source_cn: 我在此，致以最深的歉意。

say:7:1710751003:0.text: But in that moment of crisis, Captain Gwyneth did not flinch. She felled the beast, protecting you, and upholding the Crown's honor.
say:7:1710751003:0.source_cn: 但危难之际，格温妮丝队长临危不惧，斩杀巨蛛，护卫了诸位...

say:8:1710751004:0.text: I have therefore appointed her vanguard officer against the Bantus incursion in Ashvale County. I have every confidence she will serve with distinction!
say:8:1710751004:0.source_cn: 我已正式任命她前往灰影郡担任抵御班题斯的先锋官，相信她...

say:9:1710751005:0.text: As for the attack itself... I swear to you now: I will not rest until the truth is laid bare.
say:9:1710751005:0.source_cn: 至于今日的袭击……我向诸位保证，我必将彻查此事，让真相...

say:10:1710751006:0.text: Applause ripples through the hall. Orion raises a hand, and the room quiets.
say:10:1710751006:0.source_cn: 宴会厅传来一阵热烈的掌声，随后王子的声音再次响起，这一...

say:11:1710751007:0.text: I know many of you have been troubled by the disappearance of the Hall of Ancients. Rumors spread quickly in uncertain times.
say:11:1710751007:0.source_cn: 我知道，近来圣古堂无故消失，让王都人心惶惶，流言四起。

say:12:1710751008:0.text: But rest assured, I will see this resolved.
say:12:1710751008:0.source_cn: 但请诸位放心！我在此承诺——此事，必将尽快有所了结！

say:13:1710751009:0.text: Tonight, set aside your worries. Enjoy the wine and the feast.
say:13:1710751009:0.source_cn: 今夜，且放下所有的忧虑！请尽情享用美酒与佳肴！

say:14:1710751010:0.text: To the Lightbearer Empire. A toast!

say:15:1710751011:0.text: The hall erupts in cheers and the clinking of glasses.
say:15:1710751011:0.source_cn: 这番话引爆了全场，热烈的鼓掌声与干杯声此起彼伏。

say:17:1710751012:0.text: His Highness is wisdom itself! With you leading us, we have nothing to fear!
say:17:1710751012:0.source_cn: 王子殿下英明！有您在，我们就彻底放心了！

say:18:1710751013:0.text: Indeed. Orion is the Empire's true future!
say:18:1710751013:0.source_cn: 不错！奥利安才是耀光真正的未来！

say:20:1710751014:0.text: Oh my, could this be... might this possibly be the legendary Silken Snare's signature dish? His Highness is simply too generous, I am utterly unworthy of such an honor!
say:20:1710751014:0.source_cn: 这……这难道是丝绒陷阱的招牌菜？王子殿下真是太慷慨了！

say:21:1710751015:0.text: And the royal reserve wine? Exquisite...
say:21:1710751015:0.source_cn: 哦，佐餐的是王室窖藏的美酒吗？嗯……真是醇香！

say:22:1710751016:0.text: It's rather potent... my head feels... a bit light...

say:23:1710751017:0.text: You too? How odd. It must be fatigue...
say:23:1710751017:0.source_cn: 你也是？唔……一定是今天太累了……

say:26:1710751019:0.text: Clang. The hall falls into sudden stillness.
say:26:1710751019:0.source_cn: 哐当——宴会厅的喧闹声戛然而止。

say:27:1710751020:0.text: Then, one by one, heavy bodies slump across tables and carpets.
say:27:1710751020:0.source_cn: 紧接着，是此起彼伏的、重物倒在桌案和地毯上的闷响。
